title: Ramscoops
description: Space is not empty: a molecular cloud holds a thousand molecules in every cubic centimetre. Ionise them and a magnetic funnel kilometres across can sweep them in as it flies, as Bussard proposed for a starship that gathers its own fuel. Unlocks the Bussard Ramscoop.

puzzle.goal: A scoop flies at speed v through gas of density ρ. A fraction χ of it is ionised, and every ion that passes within its capture area A is funnelled in. Write m, the mass it gathers each second.
puzzle.name: Ram scoop
puzzle.ask: Find m in kg/s: χ = @{χ}, ρ = @{ρ} kg/m³, v = @{v} m/s, A = @{A} m².
puzzle.method: In one second the scoop sweeps a cylinder of gas of volume v·A; a fraction χ of its mass is caught.
